verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LM Studio serves models on OpenAI-like and Anthropic-compatible endpoints with structured outputs, and that it can connect MCP servers in the app. However, nothing documents native tool or function calling in API requests, or any reasoning-parser support. MCP client use and structured outputs are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use native tool-calling and reasoning-parser support in my requests
